title: first-run tip rail cards for console + playground
creator: Ava Martinez
body:
Goal: Design a lightweight, non-modal ‘tip rail’ pattern that surfaces contextual onboarding cards, short tooltips, and doc-link microcards across the Redwood Console and Model Playground. The pattern should provide first-run guidance for new users, progressive disclosure for power features, and shallow links to docs without disrupting workflows.

Scope:
- Tip rail component (right-anchored, dismissible) with compact card variants for: product tour steps, quick actions (create API key, link repo), and docs link cards.
- Micro tooltip style for inline fields (copyable keys, token usage, batching hints).
- Doc-link mini-cards that include title, 1-line summary, and CTA to open docs (external) or side-panel deep-dive.
- Screenshot and asset pack for release notes (3 responsive sizes: 1280x720, 1024x600, 540x360).

Deliverables:
- Figma file: /Design/Onboarding/TipRail_v1 (frames: Console, Playground, Dedicated-Flow) with component variants and tokenized spacing.
- Copy deck with microcopy alternatives and localization notes.
- Annotated spec for engineering: CSS tokens, accessible keyboard flows, ARIA roles, close/persist logic.
- Asset export: 3 screenshots per flow + SVG icons (info, link, check).

Acceptance criteria:
1) Tip rail appears only on first-run or when user clicks ‘Help’ from the header; rail can be dismissed per account and re-enabled from Settings > Onboarding.
2) Cards include a single CTA; doc-link cards open a side-panel with full doc content (desktop) or full-screen panel (mobile).
3) All microcopy reviewed by PM and Localization.
4) Screenshots exported at requested sizes and labeled for release notes.
5) Edge cases: rails must not overlap critical modals (billing flows, API key secrets) and should collapse gracefully for narrow viewports.

Notes for engineers:
- Provide a hook for 'first_run' flag in the user profile (handled by ENG-3901).
- Prefer CSS-driven animations (transform + opacity) for perf; avoid layout thrashing when rail appears.
- KV cache hints and batching tips are contextual and should be delivered only on flows where those features are present (Playground > Model settings).

Links & references:
- PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/Onboarding-Revamp
- Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/TipRail_v1
- Related tickets: ENG-3901 (first-run flag), PM-612 (onboarding roadmap), DES-2102 (icons)
comments: 2025-02-13 | Ava Martinez: Initial sketch pass uploaded to Figma. Seeking PM input on prioritization of cards (API key vs. playground tips).
2025-02-18 | Liam Patel: Scoped three card variants and added microcopy options. Dropped the multi-CTA idea; single CTA per card approved by PM.
2025-02-21 | Nora Chen (PM): Reviewed copy; prefer 'Learn more' for doc-links and 'Try it' for quick actions. Added a note to hide tips on legacy accounts.
2025-02-24 | Eng (Samir Rao): Feasibility check: side-panel open/close needs a small API for nested routing; ENG-3901 assigned. Also asked for PNG exports at 2x.
2025-02-27 | Accessibility review (R. Kim): Suggested keyboard focus trap when side-panel opens and aria-live for toast dismissals. Added to spec.
2025-03-01 | Liam Patel: Handoff package created. Figma link, export tokens, and screenshot placeholders attached. Waiting on ENG sprint slot for implementation.
